Subject: Evening compliance window request — SOC 2 + DPA deep-dive

Hi Kimberly,

We're finalizing the intake for our SOC 2 scoping and we have a hard constraint: several stakeholders are only available in the evening this week due to an internal migration. Would Redwood be able to accommodate a 60–90 minute walkthrough after 20:00 ET on either Mon 9/6 or Tue 9/7?

High-level goals for the session:
- Confirm SOC 2 scope for production services (data retention/segregation questions)
- Pen-test logistics: vendor onboarding details and timeline
- DPA review: a couple of clause clarifications procurement flagged

If you can do an evening slot, please include who from your side will join (engineer for architecture questions + PM for DPA/contract items). I'm also attaching a short questionnaire our security team completed — it may speed the call.

Thanks,
Natalie
Natalie Green
Head of Security Programs, Solace Financial

Hi Natalie — thanks for the heads up and the questionnaire, I reviewed it quickly and we can absolutely run an evening slot. Proposed options (all ET):

1) Mon, Sep 6 — 20:30–22:00 ET (90 min)
2) Tue, Sep 7 — 21:00–22:00 ET (60 min)

Attending from Redwood:
- Kimberly Park (Security/Compliance lead)
- Tessa Morgan (Solutions Engineer – architecture & evidence mapping)
- Marcus Lin (Customer Success – procurement & DPA questions)

Agenda (draft):
- 5m quick intros and goals
- 25m SOC 2 scope & evidence mapping (Tessa)
- 20m pen-test vendor logistics + handoff checklist (Marcus + vendor if present)
- 20m DPA clause Q&A and next steps (Kimberly + Marcus)
- 10m actions & timeline

I've attached a short evening agenda and a DPA extract that procurement often references. If you'd like AttackVector Labs (pen vendor) on the call, we'll need their point of contact and any pre-engagement forms; we can also do a short triage call with them beforehand.

Let me know which option works and we'll send a calendar invite with the Zoom link.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
